text:
ana: Hey — can someone drop the per-region model-health dashboard for eu-west? I need end-to-end latency + KV cache hit rate panels for a quick postmortem. Getting an SSO 'You do not have access' error when I try the grafana link.

mike: +1, we should have a shortlink. tagging @srinivas since you recently changed the org mapping.

srinivas: Furnishing now — the canonical is under the infra org not product, so some folks hit the SSO block. Shortlink: https://rwd.io/dash/model-health-eu (:star: internal). Full grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/8f3f2/model-health?orgId=4&from=now-6h.

ana (ops-bot): Note: dashboards in org "infra-monitoring" require group "infra-grafana-viewer" in Okta to view.

ana (ops-bot): If you don't have it, run: 
```
# request template (paste in ops-requests)
Subject: Grafana access request — infra-grafana-viewer
User: <your_email@redwood.com>
Reason: Access required for eu-west model health / postmortem
Role requested: Viewer
```

lee: FYI the KV hit rate panel is named "kv_cache/region_hit_rate" and you can filter by model (top-right var). Also note dedicated models sometimes don't emit per-shard cache metrics — check the 'data-source' dropdown.

jamie: For the SSO error, open a quick ticket in #help with the ops template above and cc @mike if it's urgent. I escalated one for contractor access last week and infra had to add a group exception.

mike: If you want me to add ana temporarily, I can. I need her email and the duration. Otherwise, ops can add the group.

ana (ops-bot): To request contractor access we need: contractor name, company, start/end date, and the ticket must be approved by the manager owning the project.

ana (ops-bot): Example ticket body for contractors: 
```
Subject: Contractor Grafana access - infra-grafana-viewer
Contractor: John Doe (john.doe@vendor.com)
Company: Modelops Inc
Project owner: @ana
Duration: 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30
Reason: debugging eu-west model latency spikes
```

ana (ops-bot): Once the group is added, the shortlink above will work.

ana (ops-bot): Also, alert tuning note: if you're investigating latency spikes, consider raising the non-prod latency alert threshold to 500ms for eu-west temporarily to reduce noise; open an alert-tuning PR in infra-monitoring repo.

ana (ops-bot): PR template: 
```
Repo: infra-monitoring
File: alerts/eu-west-models.yaml
Change: latency_threshold_ms: 500
Reason: temporary noise during root cause analysis
Owner: @srinivas
```

ana (ops-bot): Let me know if you want me to open the PR and link it.

ana (ops-bot): (automated) link created: https://rwd.io/dash/model-health-eu

ana (ops-bot): :thumbsup:

ana (ops-bot): grafana-bot: panel refresh may be delayed up to 30s during heavy load.

mike: Thanks — ana, drop your email here or ping #help and I'll add you for 2 days.

ana (ops-bot): Thread closed by inactivity after 20m (auto).
